question: What are the exact steps to perform a Kubernetes rollback for enterprise-core-service?
ground_truth: 1. Identify the previous stable release tag via git tag --sort=-creatordate. 2. Run helm rollback enterprise-core-service [REVISION_NUMBER] -n production. 3. Flush Redis cluster cache with FLUSHDB. 4. Post an incident summary to #incident-room on Slack.
